topic: Sensor data logging and historical analysis
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on improving the monitoring of sensor performance by creating a dedicated table in ClickHouse. This new table would log `box_mac`, `timestamp_hour`, `n_empty_packages`, and `n_full_packages` hourly for each sensor.

Participants debated the necessity of this data, with some noting that package counts alone are insufficient indicators of sensor health. Alternatives discussed included using existing ping data (`stat_ping` in PostgreSQL) or relying on monitoring systems like Victoria Metrics.

Ultimately, a solution was implemented to create a live table containing empty and full package counts, which updates every 30-60 seconds, ensuring historical data retention for analysis.
decisions: A new ClickHouse table will be created to log hourly sensor statistics (empty/full packages).
action_items: The new live table for package counts has been created.
Historical data prior to 2024-03-14 will need to be retrieved from S3 if required later.
